Class BBoolean

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.BBoolean
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObservableAttribute
public class BBoolean extends SysMLAttributeType
SysMLinJava value type for the SysML Boolean.

Note that the Boolean name clashes with the java.lang.Boolean name. Therefore, this SysMLinJava version uses the double B spelling

Note: as an ObservableValue implementation, this value type can be "observed" by other objects. ValueObservers call the addValueObserver() operation to be notiified (called-back) by the Boolean object of any change in its value. This notification will only occur if and when the Boolean value is changed by a call to the setValue() operation. So, while the Boolean value is publicly accessible and can be changed by direct assignment, the setValue() operation must be used if/when ValueObservers are to be notified of the change.
